proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item record can only say whether attunement is required, not who may attune. Staff of Fire otherwise fits the existing composite magic-item surface cleanly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Requires Attunement by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

notes: Encoded as a composite magic item: held passive fire resistance plus held charge-cast spell access with dawn recharge and last-charge destruction. The only omitted rule is the class-restricted attunement clause.
